summary: Pre-existing bug: Project.get() uses SQLite-only .get() method on PostgreSQL adapters. Not caused by InstanceTrace changes.
detail: Pre-existing bug: Project.get() at line 503 uses .get() on Drizzle query builder, which only exists on SQLite/better-sqlite3 adapters. PostgreSQL adapters (pglite, node-postgres) lack this method. Instance-bootstrap and instance tests cascade-fail through InstanceStore.load() → Project.fromDirectory() → Project.get().
